lines.t: Yahushua, your word, it breathes, before time, beyond time, within me, in the quiet where
Where my thoughts fall still, where the noise fades into nothing, there I hear you, not
in thunder alone, but in the whisper of truth that pierces deeper than sound.
Your word, alive, unshaken, holy.
It found me in the dark places and called me by name.
Thank you for your word of truth
Living light that carries me through
Every shadow bows to you
Yahushua, I rest in you
Your word is not ink on a page
It is fire in my bones
A river through my soul
It corrects me, restores me, breaks me, then makes me whole
When I wander, it calls me back
When I fall, it lifts me again
Faith rises, not from what I see
But from every promise you have spoken
Thank you for your word of truth
Anchor firm forever true
Every breath belongs to you
Yahushua
I trust in you
Heaven and earth will pass away
But your word remains
Unchanging, unfailing, eternal
It speaks and life begins
It calls and dead hearts rise
Your truth is my foundation
Your voice is my peace
Holy, holy, holy
Your word is holy
Holy, thank you for your word of truth, light that breaks the deepest blue, all I am I give to you, Yahushua, you make me new, your word, my breath, my life,
My King, Yahushua, thank you.
Thank you.
